__comment: The data floor's board over EF Core's meter (Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore — instruments microsoft.entityframeworkcore.queries, saved_changes, active_dbcontexts, compiled_query_cache_hits/misses, execution_strategy_operation_failures, optimistic_concurrency_failures) and Npgsql's (db.client.connections.usage), both exported by Goldpath.ServiceDefaults since 2026-09-03. Names are spelled as the OTel Prometheus exporter emits them (dots to underscores, _total on counters). Datasource: Prometheus scraping the OTel collector.
